hero.title: Know exactly where you stand before the real interview.
hero.subtitle: Upload your resume. Add the job description. Take a realistic AI interview. See where you are strong, where you are weak and what to improve.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Add your resume and the job description, or choose the role you are preparing for.
how.step2Body: A structured interview that goes deeper based on your answers, just like a real interviewer.
how.step3Body: Evidence-backed strengths and gaps, with a 24-hour, 3-day and 7-day improvement plan.

fair.title: Assessed on what you say and build
fair.body: Your answers, reasoning and code are what count. Accent, appearance and facial expressions are never scored.

wizard.title: New interview
wizard.subtitle: Tell us what you are preparing for. It takes about two minutes.

start.intro: We will read your inputs, work out what the role needs and plan a realistic interview for it. You will see the plan before anything starts.
start.resumeBody: It lets the interviewer ask about your own projects and experience.
start.jdBody: Paste it, upload it or share a link. It makes the interview match the job.
start.targetBody: If you do not have a job description, choosing the role is enough.
start.nextBody: We analyse the role (usually under a minute), show you the skills and rounds we plan to cover, and you choose how to take the interview.
start.privacy: Your files are private to your account. Contact details on your resume, such as your name, email or phone number, are not used in scoring.

check.title: Check your microphone and speaker
check.intro: A quick check makes sure the interviewer can hear you and you can hear the questions. It takes about a minute.
check.switchToText: Switch to a text interview instead
check.finishChecks: Finish the checks above to continue.
check.requiredFailed: Your microphone or browser cannot record answers right now. Fix the problem above and test again, or switch to a text interview.

recorder.title: Browser
recorder.pass: Your browser can record spoken answers.
recorder.noRecorder: This browser cannot record audio. Use the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, or switch to a text interview.
recorder.noFormat: This browser cannot record audio in a format we support. Use the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, or switch to a text interview.
recorder.videoPass: Your browser can record video and spoken answers.
recorder.noVideoFormat: This browser cannot record video in a format we support. Use the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, or switch to a text interview.

mic.title: Microphone
mic.intro: Press Test microphone, allow access when your browser asks, then say a few words.
mic.listening: Listening… say a few words, for example your name.
mic.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Click the lock or microphone icon in your browser's address bar, allow the microphone for this site, then press Test again.
mic.noDevice: We could not find a microphone. Connect a microphone or headset, then press Test again.
mic.inUse: Your microphone is being used by another app. Close other apps that use it (calls, recorders), then press Test again.
mic.unsupported: This browser cannot use a microphone here. Use the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
mic.other: We could not open your microphone. Check that it is connected and allowed, then press Test again.
mic.quiet: Your voice sounds very quiet. Move closer to the microphone or raise its volume in your system settings, then test again. You can also continue.
mic.silent: We did not hear anything. Check that the right microphone is selected and not muted, then test again. You can also continue.
mic.noMeter: Your microphone works, but we could not measure its level in this browser. You can continue.

speaker.title: Speaker or headphones
speaker.intro: Press Play test sound and listen.
speaker.question: Did you hear it?
speaker.noAnswer: Turn up the volume, check that your speaker or headphones are connected and selected, then play the sound again. You can also continue: questions are always shown on screen too.
speaker.noAudio: This browser cannot play the test sound. Questions are always shown on screen too.

network.title: Connection
network.slow: Your connection is a little slow ({{ms}} ms). Answers may take longer to process.
network.verySlow: Your connection is slow ({{ms}} ms). Move closer to your Wi-Fi router or close other downloads.
network.failed: We could not measure your connection. Check that you are online.

done.videoBody: Your camera, microphone and speaker are checked. Next, review the rules and start your interview.
